items.fact: judo-cli.jar (~99 MB, two blobs in history) is tracked despite .gitignore and reports 1.0.0 while the pom pins 1.1.0.20260126…, so CI likely runs the committed jar. Untrack with git rm --cached, keep gitignored; pom download-model-cli profile (JUDO Nexus -> tools/) becomes the only source; bump pinned version; CI downloads explicitly. Purging history is opt-in (needs force-push and team sign-off).

items.topic: Sweep design: remote default branch at pinned SHA, kind column
items.fact: Sweep the remote default branch (develop) at a recorded SHA, not local checkouts (Rackinspect has 17 local worktrees of same repo). PROJECTS.md needs a 'kind' column (app/platform/agent-plugin) and analyzed branch+SHA. Old PROGRESS.md files date from March 2026; best-practices PROGRESS recorded no SHAs ('Last SHA -'), so must be a full run. Rackinspect base SHA 32619ec no longer exists (history rewritten); mlszksz base f2b7101 still valid. Sweep A (app patterns) vs Sweep B (platform knowledge: reference vs distil).

items.topic: kb guard: search kb before source searches
items.fact: The harness emits '[kb] 3 consecutive searches without consulting the knowledge base' and blocks/warns; run kb_search / kb agents <path> / kb get before repeated source greps. Also large tool outputs are replaced by stubs; use ctx_execute/ctx_batch to summarize.
